commit.message:
Keep Mode 17 semantics within the fixed bootstrap reserve

The integrated thread-install observations make the unsectioned Mode 17 kernel end at0x389000, exceeding its existing0x380000 limit. Apply the established per-function/per-data section and linker-reachability policy to this mode; retain every original source input and the unchanged linker, bootstrap mapping and reserve. The resulting kernel ends at0x2fc000.

Validation: actual complete M5 semantics QEMU gate passes with both the previous and freshly rebuilt current-source compiler; all seven semantic markers, post-test IRQ ordering and one-second survival remain required. Two build-recipe tests pass for both linker invocation variants. Independent review verifies all65 ordered source inputs and2,456 object symbol facts; removing Mode17 from the policy makes both negative controls fail. Full changed-source CI remains required.

Assisted-by: Codex agents for reproduction, implementation, execution checks and independent review.
